{{Current events header|2015|06|29}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Four [[Israeli]]s were shot and injured in a drive-by shooting attack near [[Shilo]], as a manhunt begins for the suspects. [http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4674258,00.html (YNet)]
*A [[Palestinian]] woman was arrested after stabbing and seriously wounding a female [[IDF]] soldier at a checkpoint near [[Bethlehem]]. [http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/.premium-1.663489 (Haaretz)]
*Five [[Chad]]ian security officials and six militants have been killed during an explosion in a raid in the capital [[N'Djamena]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-33310745 (BBC)] 
*[[Egypt]]'s state prosecutor [[Hisham Barakat]] dies in a bomb attack in [[Cairo]]. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/06/29/egypt-state-prosecutor-dies-in-bomb-attack-in-cairo/ (AP via Fox News)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2015–present)|Afghan Civil War]]:
**According to witnesses who fled fighting in [[Nangarhar province]], fighters loyal to [[ISIS|Islamic State]] seize substantial territory in [[Afghanistan]] for the first time, wresting areas in the east from rival [[Taliban]] insurgents in a new threat to stability, scorching opium poppy fields that help to fund the Taliban's campaign to overthrow the [[Afghan government]]. [http://www.newsweek.com/islamic-state-seizes-territory-afghanistan-threatens-stability-348083 (Newsweek)]
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]]
**A [[car bomb]] explodes behind a military hospital in the [[Yemen]]i capital [[Sanaa]] causing dozens of casualties. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/db34d0896262437184b7756ef6c6de96/car-bomb-explodes-near-military-hospital-yemeni-capital (AP)] 
;Arts and culture
*Chinese state-run media reports the [[Great Wall of China|Great Wall]] losing around 30% of its structure due to natural conditions and human activities. [http://news.discovery.com/earth/chinas-great-wall-is-slowly-disappearing-150629.htm (AFP via Discovery)]
;International relations
* The [[Israeli Navy]] intercepts and takes control of the lone ship still involved in [[Freedom Flotilla III]] and pilots it to [[Ashdod]]. The other three ships involved had already turned back after being intercepted. Israel offered all ships to unload their humanitarian aid cargo in Israeli ports and transport it into Gaza for free but the ships refused. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/197406#.VZC2EF3D-M8 (Israel National News)][http://www.timesofisrael.com/three-of-four-flotilla-vessels-turn-back-one-heads-toward-gaza/ (Times Of Israel)]
*The [[United States]] [[Office of Personnel Management]] closes down its system for employee background checks following the theft of millions of records in a [[computer hacking]] incident suspected to be conducted by Chinese hackers. [http://www.breakingnews.com/item/2015/06/29/us-office-of-personnel-management-shuts-down-syste/ (Breaking News)]
;Law and crime
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] upholds the use of [[capital punishment]] by [[lethal injection]] involving [[midazolam]]. [http://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2015/06/29/supreme-court-lethal-injection/28648145/ (''USA Today'')]
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] strikes down the [[Environmental Protection Agency]]'s limit on mercury emissions from power plants because it did not take costs of the regulations into consideration. [http://www.wsj.com/articles/high-court-strikes-down-epa-limits-on-mercury-emissions-1435590069 (''Wall Street Journal'')]
*The [[California State Legislature]] passes a bill which would enact a state requirement for the vaccination of children enrolled in schools. The bill is now pending [[Jerry Brown|Governor Jerry Brown]]'s approval before going into law. Vaccines are known to cause rare yet dangerous side effects and the bill may be a violation of the ethical principle of [[Informed consent]], [http://www.latimes.com/local/political/la-me-ln-california-legislature-expected-to-pass-tough-vaccination-law-20150628-story.html (Los Angeles Times)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Burundian legislative election, 2015]]
**Voters in [[Burundi]] go to the polls for a legislative election with several polling places attacked overnight. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/06/polling-booths-open-controversial-burundi-elections-150629043001015.html (Al-Jazeera)]
*[[Puerto Rico government-debt crisis]]
**Governor [[Alejandro García Padilla]] said the region has failed attempts and is unable to pay off the $72 billion debt. [http://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2015/06/29/puerto-rico-debt-crisis-default/29458475/ (USA Today)]
;Sports
*[[Guus Hiddink]] the head coach of the [[Netherlands national football team]] prematurely resigns before the end of his term. [http://www.espnfc.com/international/story/2507624/guus-hiddink-to-step-down-as-netherlands-coach-report (Espnfc)]
